summary: Famous Brooklyn preacher (Lafayette Avenue Presbyterian) and author; John's 5th cousin 5x removed.
bio:
Path: Mary Tuthill → Azariah Horton → Mary Horton Morrell → Charles Horton Morrell → Louisa Frances Morrell → Theodore. His mother's 'paternal great-grandfather was the Rev. Azariah Horton'.

Akerly ([R4-S2]) independently names Azariah Horton as 'ancestor of the Rev. Theodore L. Cuyler, of Brooklyn', confirming the link already drawn from Cuyler's own Recollections. 5th cousin 5 times removed.
sources: Cuyler, Recollections of a Long Life, https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/12549
[R4-S1] Wikipedia, 'Theodore L. Cuyler' (intro via MediaWiki API) (secondary) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theodore_L._Cuyler

[R4-S2] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), p. 8 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker
